articles.title: Bitcoin bears pay to bet on further declines as futures positions near yearly lows
articles.snippet: Overall demand for leveraged exposure remains weak, marked by sliding futures open interest. The capital that's still in the market appears skewed toward bearish positions.

articles.title: Vitalik Buterin maps Ethereum’s shift beyond a blockchain in sweeping 2030 vision
articles.snippet: Buterin wants Ethereum to do far more work without forcing every computer on the network to repeat the same calculations.

articles.title: How months of work on the Clarity Act all fell apart
articles.snippet: Interviews with industry participants and legislative aides paint a picture of a blown bill-writing process, with sources pointing to nearly every facet of the bill's development and the debate around it as contributing factors to this month's failed vote.

articles.title: Strategy proposes daily dividends to bring STRC back toward $100
articles.snippet: STRC has remained below $100 since May, despite a 12% dividend rate and roughly $1 billion in preferred share buybacks.

articles.title: Bitcoin drops under $83K as liquidity hunting keeps bulls from targeting yearly open
articles.snippet: Bitcoin joined US stock futures in dropping on Monday after US president Donald Trump did not commit to permanently halting strikes on Iran.
